metadata.name: OpenPoke synthetic Execution Agent routing benchmark
metadata.description: Hand-authored synthetic agent names, delegated instructions, user requests, and routing labels. No real user data.
metadata.labeling: Relevant agent IDs and expected actions are specified independently of evaluator ranking code.
limitations: Labels are hand-authored by one evaluator and have not been independently reviewed.
The offline hash-vector mode is a deterministic regression proxy, not a semantic embedding model.
The benchmark tests retrieval from agent names and original delegated instructions, not later execution outputs.
Live-provider scores on this small synthetic set do not establish production performance.
